summary: User asked whether the bot can get a VOD download link from a twitch.tv/videos/... URL. Answered no: the bot only notifies about live stream starts; it has no VOD/download logic, Helix Videos API usage, or download URL support. Noted that such a URL would be misparsed as username "videos", and that Twitch Helix does not expose direct download links anyway.
current_status: twitch-telegram-bot remains a live-stream notification bot; no VOD download capability exists or was requested to be added.
